_what: POINTER, not a checkpoint. G-160 PARCEL 1's CP1 was filed at this path and was OVERWRITTEN IN PLACE by PARCEL 2's CP1. Parcel 2's CP1 has since been renamed for unambiguity, so this path now holds only this pointer. Nothing is being hidden and nothing is being reconstructed: Parcel 1's CP1 body is GONE.

pathHistory.originally: Parcel 1's CP1, filed 2026-09-18 by seat cente-vsc-g160. Its own disclosure said of itself: 'This CP1 was filed AFTER the plan-review copy of the check was built and proven, and BEFORE the smart-files copy was built. It is not backdated and it does not claim to have gated the plan-review work.'
pathHistory.then: PARCEL 2's CP1, filed 2026-09-18T20:18:00Z by seat cente-vsc-g160p2, whose `supersedes` field named the overwrite explicitly.
pathHistory.now: Parcel 2's CP1 has been renamed to _inbox/2026-09-18_g160-served-commit-parity_p2_cp1.json so that Parcel 2's artifacts carry Parcel-2-specific names and this cannot silently recur for them. Parcel 2's CP2 and close use ..._p2_cp2.json and ..._p2_close.json for the same reason.
pathHistory.whyNotRecoverable: The file was untracked in the seat worktree, so git never held it. Searched: git history across ALL refs in both repos (`git log --all --diff-filter=A -- '*g160*cp1*'` and by exact path -- both EMPTY, so the path was never tracked anywhere); the whole seat worktree at full depth (the only match is this pointer file, with no .bak/~ /copy variant); the integration repo's _inbox (holds no g160 artifact); and every Cursor cache under C:/Users/cente/.cursor/projects, including agent-transcripts -- where a hit turned out to hold only this lane's own quotations of CP1's self-description, not the body (an 84 KB / 60-line index with no `preRegisteredFalsifiers`). Not searched by content: P:/tmp, a 7.3M-file scratch tree of unrelated lanes, where a bounded name search to depth 3 found only this parcel's own g160 tooling. There is no other copy.
whereItsSubstanceSurvives: _inbox/2026-09-18_g160-served-commit-parity_close.json -- Parcel 1's close, whose `filedAtNote` records that CP1 was filed after the plan-review build and before the smart-files build, and that CP1's own `disclosure` field says so rather than backdating itself.
_inbox/2026-09-18_g160-served-commit-parity_p2_cp1.json -- Parcel 2's CP1, whose `supersedes` field quotes Parcel 1's CP1 self-description verbatim.
_inbox/2026-09-18_g160-served-commit-parity_p2_close.json -- Parcel 2's close, `recordIntegrity`, which states the loss and its limits in full.
